Info

Concrete transmission converter for bidirectional joint angles and motor steps mapping.

class scaralang.core.service.kinematics.transmission.joint_step_transmission_converter.JointStepTransmissionConverter(*, transmission: TransmissionParameters)[source]¶

Bases: object

Bidirectional transmission converter between joint space and discrete motor steps.

It defines:

attributes:
_transmission - Mechanical gear ratio and motor resolution parameters.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes converter with transmission parameters.
angles_to_steps - Converts joint radians/mm into discrete motor steps.
steps_to_angles - Converts discrete motor steps into joint radians/mm.
steps_per_rad - Calculates motor step scale factor per radian of joint rotation.
steps_per_mm_z - Calculates motor step scale factor per linear mm of Z travel.
_transmission: TransmissionParameters¶
angles_to_steps(theta1_rad: float, theta2_rad: float, z_mm: float, theta4_rad: float) → tuple[int, int, int, int][source]¶

Converts joint angles and linear Z travel into discrete motor steps.

Parameters:

  • theta1_rad – Shoulder joint angle in radians.

  • theta2_rad – Elbow joint angle in radians.

  • z_mm – Linear vertical travel in millimeters.

  • theta4_rad – Wrist joint angle in radians.

Returns:

Tuple of (j1, j2, z, j4) integer microsteps.

steps_per_mm_z() → float[source]¶

Calculates motor step scale factor per linear millimeter of Z travel.

Returns:

Steps per millimeter float value.

steps_per_rad(gear_ratio: float) → float[source]¶

Calculates motor step scale factor per radian of joint rotation.

Parameters:

gear_ratio – Mechanical reduction ratio.

Returns:

Steps per radian float value.

steps_to_angles(step1: int, step2: int, step3: int, step4: int) → tuple[float, float, float, float][source]¶

Converts discrete motor steps into joint angles and linear Z travel.

Parameters:

  • step1 – Shoulder joint motor microsteps.

  • step2 – Elbow joint motor microsteps.

  • step3 – Z-axis vertical motor microsteps.

  • step4 – Wrist joint motor microsteps.

Returns:

Tuple of (theta1_rad, theta2_rad, z_mm, theta4_rad).
